title: Studio Blue Green SW 0047 — real exterior photo collection

groups.title: Old Drake · Charleston area, South Carolina
groups.credit: Lehigh Land & Building Company, LLC · Houzz
groups.evidence: The builder explicitly identifies Studio Blue Green SW 0047 on the siding and stucco in its answer attached to the first photograph. Both exterior views from the seven-photo project are included; the other five entries are interiors. This is a direct professional attribution. The photographs look quite gray and show pale trim, while the written answer names Hunt Club trim, so that visual discrepancy is preserved here rather than explained away.
groups.palette: Builder’s stated palette: siding and stucco — Studio Blue Green SW 0047; trim including balusters — Hunt Club SW 6468; louvers and top rail — Peristyle Brass SW 0043. See discrepancy note above.

groups.credit: Amanda Scacchi · Boffo Real Estate Group / Stellar MLS via Compass · Paint Color Consultants

The newer sources do not independently name the paint or establish that it was never repainted; their color attribution is inherited from the earlier reference set. They remain secondary attributions. Broad acreage aerials, interiors and duplicate copies were excluded.

groups.title: Bungalow 404 · conflicting paint identifications

exclusions.title: Sherwin-Williams official color page
exclusions.reason: Confirms the exact color identity, SW 0047. Its featured real-home images found during this search were interiors, so those are omitted.

exclusions.title: CBID / Your Nest Design colonial-house illustration
exclusions.reason: An unnamed colonial-house image is captioned Studio Blue Green, but its original project and actual applied paint could not be established. A color illustration or recolored reference could not be ruled out; it is not included as a real applied-paint example.

exclusions.title: Savannah historic-preservation packet: color-matched existing paint
exclusions.reason: The packet contains real existing-house photos and proposes SW 0047 to match existing colors. That does not establish that the photographed existing siding was painted with Studio Blue Green. Proposed construction and sample matches are not counted as applied-paint photos.

exclusions.title: Pontata and PLAN Home repeated exterior images
exclusions.reason: The identifiable exterior compositions repeat the Amanda, Nina and Sarah reference sets. Repeated sizes and reposts are counted once, using the larger recovered files where available.

exclusions.title: Bucci Paint public-video search lead
exclusions.reason: A search result associates a contractor exterior video with a Natural Linen / Westhighland White / Studio Blue Green palette. The public page required login and did not expose a usable project photo or complete caption. This is an unresolved lead, not a confirmed saved photo.

exclusions.title: DecorCreek exterior reference and Pinterest reposts
exclusions.reason: An indexed Studio Blue Green article and exterior pin were found, but the article redirected to the general site and the pin did not expose a verifiable original project. No photo from that lead is represented as a documented paint application.

exclusions.title: Organized-ish garage entry
exclusions.reason: The owner names Studio Blue Green, but the photographed entry is inside the garage rather than an outdoor house facade. Excluded from this exterior collection.

exclusions.title: Houzz suggestions, renderings and unrelated completed colors
exclusions.reason: The homeowner’s finished house in this discussion uses Miller paint; Studio Blue Green appears in an inspiration reply. Other discussions offer proposed door colors or online recolorings rather than finished SW 0047 paint jobs.

exclusions.title: Interior projects, paint chips and generated exterior examples
exclusions.reason: Bathrooms, kitchens, bedrooms, palette strips and paint swatches are excluded. Housepaint AI examples and unsubstantiated generated-looking exterior illustrations are not real applied-paint evidence. Builder option catalogs and HOA schedules alone also do not qualify.

exclusions.title: Bungalow 404 older source availability
exclusions.reason: Indexed text preserves the paint discussion, but the live article returned not found during research. Its old Flickr front/rear files also returned not found. Two different recovered real photographs remain in the separately labeled uncertain section.

methodology: Broad public-web research using Studio Blue Green, Sherwin-Williams, SW 0047/SW0047 and exterior, house, siding, stucco, porch, door, trim, painting and before/after terms. Reviewed text and image results, seven pages of the exact-color exterior search, builder and painter sources, homeowner discussions, Houzz photos and paint answers, public social references, Pinterest, historic blogs, real-estate listings, manufacturer pages and architectural packets. Expanded the nine-photo reference database, screened the Southport listing’s 47 images, and traced the seven Old Drake project entries (two exteriors, five interiors). Retained photographs were visually inspected; known duplicate compositions, sizes and reposts were removed. The expanded 28-photo main collection contains two builder-identified body views, eighteen secondary body attributions and eight exterior-door/entry views. The follow-up traced original designer and homeowner accounts, inspected Sarah Karon’s exterior portfolio, and screened all 43 listing photographs of the porch house. Ten additional siding/body photos were retained: eight listing views and one original homeowner photo of the porch house, plus one designer-portfolio close-up of the existing Atlanta bungalow. These are additional views of two existing houses, not ten new houses. Same-house visual matching extends the secondary paint attribution; the additional source pages do not independently confirm SW 0047. Six of those eight door views have primary homeowner or listing evidence; two rely on secondary publications. Two photographs of Bungalow 404 have conflicting color identifications and remain outside the main count. Source groups are not a count of unique houses. No recoloring or AI imagery was introduced. Source identification is not physical verification of paint or camera color. This is a thorough public-web collection, not a guarantee of every photograph ever posted; private, deleted, unindexed and inaccessible sources may contain more.
